description: This file contains utility functions for throughput data processing, including data rate formatting, data rate calculation, timestamp formatting, chart data preparation, y-axis unit determination, and data rate conversion, specifically tailored for throughput metrics visualization.

methods.name: formatDataRate
methods.description: Converts bytes per second to a human-readable data rate with appropriate units (bps, Kbps, Mbps, Gbps).

methods.name: calculateDataRate
methods.description: Calculates the data rate (rx and tx) from current and previous cumulative byte counts over a given interval.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into HH:MM:SS string for chart labels.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Prepares chart data series from a time series of throughput data, including labels and datasets for Tx and Rx.

methods.name: determineYAxisUnit
methods.description: Determines the appropriate unit (bps, Kbps, Mbps, Gbps) for the y-axis based on maximum data rate in the dataset.

methods.name: convertToUnit
methods.description: Converts a data rate from bytes per second to a specified unit for display.
